<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { ZxSchemaForm } from '@zxio/schema-form/form-create';
import type { SchemaFormInstance } from '@zxio/schema-form/form-create';
import '@zxio/schema-form/style.css';
import type { PostValues,PostApi } from './domain';
import { createPostRules, createPostSave } from './post-form';
const props=defineProps<{initial:PostValues;postId?:number;api:PostApi}>();
const initial={...props.initial};
const form=ref<SchemaFormInstance<PostValues>>();
const save=createPostSave(props.api,props.postId);

<template><ZxSchemaForm ref="form" :initial="initial" :create-rules="createPostRules" :save="save" :columns="2"/><button :disabled="form?.pending" @click="form?.submit()">保存</button><button :disabled="form?.pending" @click="form?.reset()">恢复</button></template>
